svg.aria-label: HealthAI Triage. An AI that can never talk you out of an emergency. In plain words: Describe your symptoms in your own words and get one of three answers: care at home, see a doctor today, or go to the emergency room, with the reasons and sources. Fixed safety rules check every case too, and the most cautious answer always wins, so a wrong AI answer can never hide an emergency. Under the hood: Tool-calling agent over hybrid dense and keyword RAG with Groq to NVIDIA NIM failover. Final level = max(red-flag rules, agent, conformal second opinion), so no model can lower the rules' level. 60-case eval gated in CI: rules alone catch 100% of red-flag cases and 85% of emergencies. 135 tests with a fake LLM transport.
